verdict: Ads are delivering leads; the intake process needs urgent attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 171 leads from Meta at a cost per lead of $12.40 — and the 7-day trend is moving in the right direction, with leads up 7.5% and cost per lead down slightly. The problem is downstream: 142 of those leads reached your CRM, 29 are unaccounted for, and zero opportunities were created from any of them, which points to a breakdown in how leads are being received and followed up, not in the ads themselves. Google Business Profile actions also dropped sharply this past week — down 48% versus the prior week — and that decline held across three consecutive days, so it is being watched closely. The priority right now is repairing the intake process so the leads the ads are generating actually move into your pipeline.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period from Meta advertising
cost per lead this period, trending down week over week
opportunities created in your CRM from those 171 leads — intake needs immediate repair

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile actions fell 48% week-over-week and have shown zero activity for the last three days, signaling a drop in organic search visibility.
watch_item.fix: Profile posting cadence and optimization are being reviewed this week to diagnose and reverse the decline.
